dct_title_s: Madison County, Iowa, 1938, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKF; form of individual image numbering: BKF-1-[number], BKF-2-[number], BKF-3-[number], BKF-4-[number], or BKF-5-[number]."Date of completion December 5, 1938" Flown by Iowa Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
